description: Net daily flows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs in USD millions: the latest trading day split by fund (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC and others), 5-day and 30-day sums, and up to 30 recent daily totals (set days, default 10). Use this when the user asks about ETF inflows or outflows, institutional demand or a specific fund's flow. US trading days only, so weekends and US holidays have no entry; the latest day usually lags one US session. Flows only, not fund holdings or prices.

days.description: Number of recent daily totals to return (default 10)

name: get_bitcoin_etf_flows
title: US spot Bitcoin ETF flows
